description: Count the press runs started across a month boundary in a cider press journal that rotated at the month end and switched its stamps from ISO to day/month/year. DISTILL-CANARY-b04c087e

files.README.md:
# Josselin Cider - press house journal

The press rotates its journal at the March month end. Stamps were ISO
(yyyy-mm-dd) through March and dd/mm/yyyy from April on, and both sections
sit in this file. One line per run start and per run finish.
